sources.subject: Re: Serial cable ROHS sheet
sources.evidence:
VERIFIED PARTS: the serial thread is real (retry_packets/r_021.json, INBOX:5210). kyu 2021-09-03 asks only "the ROHS sheet for Serial cable"; BOR (guzhiyi@bor-cable.com) replies same day with 9 raw-material RoHS PDFs including SPCC-ROHS.pdf. No model code in the PDF (sample = "SPCC / Silver-grey metal sheet", client FOSHAN SHUNDA ZIHE TRADE, SGS CANEC2100165601, 11 Jan 2021) or in the mail. family_catalog_short.json contains exactly 7 serial-cable families, all LS-SER-*, all from the same BOR drawing batch (QJ/XYT-A2009xx..A2014xx, received 2021-12-12), and every one specifies D-Sub connectors with "니켈도금 쉘" (nickel-plated shell) plus 4 nickel-plated screws, i.e. SPCC steel hardware; BOM (7/0.12 CCS conductors + AL foil + PVC jacket) matches the material packs. No other serial/RS-232 family exists in the catalogue, so within "serial cable" the match is unique (LS-PRT-25C is a CN36 parallel printer cable, LS-GEN-DB9FF is a gender changer, not cables in this thread).

REFUTATION 1 - a cited corroboration is factually false. I hashed every SPCC-ROHS.pdf under attachments_raw/: the 2022-07-27 new-supplier pack is INBOX_7770 (Aluminum Foil / Conductor(CCS) / Contact Pin / H62 / PBT / PVC / SPCC) and ITS SPCC-ROHS.pdf is sha1 2bf68bb27101b8278c1c55c4f022bc0e7a2acd6e - a DIFFERENT document. fdb8f31 occurs only in INBOX_5014, INBOX_5210, INBOX_8658. So "attached it again in the 2022-07-27 new-supplier pack" does not hold for this sha1, and the archive's proper serial-cable SPCC report for the current (new-factory) LS-SER line is 2bf68bb (still unresolved), not this file.

REFUTATION 2 - models=[] is wrong. final_data.json already resolves this exact sha1 (sweep1, confidence high) to LS-HRGB-15MM-XM and LS-SRGB-15MM-XM via INBOX:8658 "Re: ROHS for High VGA cable" (2022-11-14, kyu's request names LS-HRGB-15MM-Xm) and INBOX:5014 "Re: ROHS2" (2021-08-13, kyu's request names LS-SRGB-15MM-Xm); its stored name is already "LS-HRGB-15MM-XM_RoHS[원자재]_SPCC-ROHS.pdf". This is consistent with Gu's own sentence in the serial thread: "Actually serial cable material is same as VGA cable material" - i.e. fdb8f31 is the VGA-line steel report handed over as a substitute for the serial request.

CONCLUSION: the LS-SER-* family attachment survives (BOR deliberately supplied this file as the serial-cable RoHS answer, and SPCC is genuinely the LS-SER shell/screw material - the same raw-material linking pattern already used for CCA-ROHS -> 6 models, 03be7c8c SPCC-ROHS -> LS-PS2-6MM-1.8M, 铁壳-SPCC -> LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM), but the record must keep the two VGA models that kyu named explicitly, so the proposed set differs. Caveat for the chatbot: scope=raw_material, deliverable=false - never serve alone for a finished-product RoHS request, and for LS-SER-* prefer the new-factory pack (INBOX:7770, sha1 2bf68bb...) which supersedes this 2021 VGA-line sheet. title_ko: 제품 사양도면 + 자재명세(BOM) — PS/2 케이블 DIN 6P 수-수, LS-PS2-6MM-1.8M/5M/10M (BOR 작성, 2019-01-18 B/0 원판)

issuer: BOR International Trade Co., Ltd (도면 내 표기; CUSTOMER: LANstar)
product_in_doc: PS2 CABLE, DIN 6P/M-DIN 6P/M (LANstar) — MODEL LIST: LS-PS2-6MM-1.8M / LS-PS2-6MM-5M / LS-PS2-6MM-10M

sources.subject: Re: rohs sheet for PS2 cable
sources.evidence: 동일 스레드 요청: kyu 2024-04-09 "we need ROHS sheet for ps2 cable" → BOR(Gu) 2024-04-10 회신 "please check attached test report of all materials"와 함께 AL/CCS/H62/PE/PVC/SPCC 6종 원자재 성적서 송부. 즉 이 문서는 'PS2 케이블의 구성 자재' 증빙임이 스레드에서 공급사 진술로 확정된다. Lanstar 패밀리 카탈로그에서 PS/2 케이블은 정확히 두 패밀리뿐이며(LS-PS2-6MF: DIN 6P M-F, LS-PS2-6MM: DIN 6P M-M) 둘 다 같은 공급사 BOR 작성 도면이고, 두 패밀리의 BOM이 모두 '7/0.10 CCS×6C + CCS 드레인 + 알루미늄 마일러(AM) + PVC 자켓'으로 알루미늄 실드를 포함한다. 또한 같은 메일의 형제 첨부 SPCC-ROHS.pdf(sha1 03be7c8c30…)는 1차 패스에서 이미 LS-PS2-6MM-1.8M으로 연결되어 있다. [검증완료]

sources.subject: Serial cable ROHS sheet
sources.evidence: The thread scopes the whole attachment set to one product type: kyu 2022-07-22 "We need ROHS2.0 sheet for serial cable with New factory"; Gu 2022-07-25 "we already ask for the new supplier to prepare the SGS sheets"; Gu 2022-07-27 "Just prepared the ROHS for serial cable of new supplier. Please check attached SGS testing report for materials" with the 7 material sheets (Aluminum Foil / Conductor(CCS) / Contact Pin / H62 / PBT / PVC / SPCC). No model code is written anywhere in the six mails, so the link is made through the product type. The Lanstar catalogue contains exactly seven serial-cable families and no others: LS-SER-9MF, LS-SER-9MM, LS-SER-9MFC, LS-SER-9FF, LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M, LS-SER-25MF, LS-SER-25MM. Every one of those catalogue entries is annotated "2021-12-12 신규 협력사 수신" (drawings received from the NEW supplier, drawing numbers QJ/XYT-A200900 / A201000 / A201300 / A201400), i.e. the same "new factory" this RoHS request is about, and their construction matches the attached material set exactly: "금도금 핀(gold-plated pin), 니켈도금 쉘" for this Contact Pin gold-layer sheet, plus CCS conductor / AL foil / PVC. Other D-sub families in the catalogue were checked and excluded: LS-PRT-25C(-XX) is a parallel printer cable (CN36-DB25, BOR drawing 2022-11-25) and LS-GEN-DB9FF is a gender changer, neither of which is a "serial cable". [검증완료]

sources.subject: Serial cable ROHS sheet
sources.evidence: The thread is entirely and only about serial cable: kyu 2021-09-03 'Could you please send the ROHS sheet for Serial cable?'; kyu 2022-07-22 'We need ROHS2.0 sheet for serial cable with New factory'; Gu 2022-07-27 'Just prepared the ROHS for serial cable of new supplier. Please check attached SGS testing report for materials' — SPCC-ROHS.pdf is one of those 7 material reports. No model code appears anywhere in the thread and none appears in the SGS report, so the link is made through the catalogue: the only serial (D-sub) cable line Lanstar buys from BOR is the LS-SER-* family group, and every one of those catalogue entries is a supplier CAD drawing 'received 2021-12-12' from the new partner factory (drawing numbers QJ/XYT-A200900, A201000, A201300, A201400), i.e. exactly the 'New factory' whose RoHS 2.0 file this is. The LS-SER-9MFC / LS-SER-9MM datasheets specify solder-type D-sub connectors with nickel-plated shells, which is the part SPCC cold-rolled steel is used for, and the same package also contains Contact Pin and H62 brass reports for the pins. No other Lanstar family in the catalogue is a D-sub serial cable. [검증완료]

sources.subject: Serial cable ROHS sheet
sources.evidence: No model code in the PDF or the thread. Thread: kyu 2022-07-22 "We need ROHS2.0 sheet for serial cable with New factory"; BOR 2022-07-25 "we already ask for the new supplier to prepare the SGS sheets"; BOR 2022-07-27 "Just prepared the ROHS for serial cable of new supplier" attaching Conductor(CCS)-ROHS.pdf with Aluminum Foil, Contact Pin, H62, PBT, PVC, SPCC. That BOM (CCS conductor + aluminium foil + PVC) matches the Lanstar serial-cable drawings exactly - every LS-SER family is specified as "nC+1 CCS / AL foil / PVC" (LS-SER-9MM 9C+1, LS-SER-9FF and LS-SER-9MFC 7C+1, LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M 6C+1, LS-SER-25MM/25MF 25C+1) - and the catalogue has no other serial-cable line. The LS-SER drawings are themselves logged as received 2021-12-12 from the 신규 협력사 (new supplier), consistent with this new-factory RoHS pack. [검증완료]

sources.subject: for slim patch cord and flat patch
sources.evidence: Cited evidence verifies: BCTC2511173018C names applicant/manufacturer Xiangshan Bor and scope "Network slim patch cord" CAT.5E-CAT.8.1, all shieldings/jackets/colours (no customer model); the covering mail (guzhiyi->kyu 2026-07-08, r_008.json) says only "certificats for slim patch cord and flat patch cord" and its quoted request (LS-6UTPD/6UTPC/6STPD/USB-AMBM/5UTPAD, RoHS+MSDS) is unrelated; INBOX:5564, INBOX:5570, Sent:1898, Sent:1902 contain verbatim "LS-6A-UTP-1M change to LS-6AUTP-xM", "LS-7-SSTP-xMB change to LS-6AFTP-xM" and "the color of LS-SL6-xW series"; family_catalog.json confirms BOR drawings T2021070701 (LS-SL6 SLIM U/UTP CAT.6), T2021101902 (LS-6AUTP SLIM U/UTP CAT.6A), T2021101903 (LS-6AFTP SLIM U/FTP CAT.6A). REFUTED point: the claim's key premise "exactly three BOR slim patch-cord families and no others" is false. LS-BFTP7 is a fourth BOR slim family - "Slim Easy Bent U/FTP Cat.6A Patch Cord", 32AWG BC TPE - documented in the 2025 "slim easy bent patch cords" thread (INBOX:18892 "As for slim easy bent patch cords... A fourth active BOR slim family is omitted — LS-BFTP7 = "Slim Easy Bent U/FTP Cat.6A Patch Cord", 32AWG BC, TPE jacket, OD 4.0mm, 0.5M~20M. Evidence: BOR datasheet LS-BFTP7-xxM.pdf issued by BOR INTERNATIONAL TRADE 2025-03-06, delivered in INBOX:19152 under thread subject "slim easy bent patch cords" together with "Slim Easy Bent U_FTP Cat.6A Patch Cord-2M/-20M.pdf"; later Fluke files under subject "Test report of SLIM EASY BENT U/FTP PATCH CORD"; catalogue key LS-BFTP7 exists. It falls inside the report scope on category (CAT.6A), shielding (U/FTP), form factor (slim) and jacket (TPE — and it is the only Lanstar slim cord with a TPE jacket, the other three being LSZH). It is also the same BCTC campaign: kyu's 2026-01-30 mail "ROHS Compliance for LS-BFTP7 Series" (Sent:6683) triggered BOR's BCTC2511421501 RoHS (tested from 2025-11-07), and these EMC reports were tested 2025-11-08~13 at the same lab.

Slim Cat.8 was quoted but cancelled by Lanstar in 2022 (INBOX:6615), and LS-8SFTP is a round S/FTP cord. sources.subject: rs232 cable (OEM)
sources.evidence:
The thread quotes are accurate, but the catalogue match is affirmatively wrong, not merely weak.

(1) DIFFERENT SKU, PROVEN BY THE SUPPLIER'S OWN DRAWING SET. BOR mail INBOX:6082 (2021-12-12, "DATA sheet of New Supplier") attaches BOTH "DB25M-DB9F-3C+1-2M.pdf" AND "LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M.pdf" as two separate data sheets in the same mail. The first is the item in this RoHS thread (Gu re-sends exactly that file on 2022-12-05 as the datasheet for "DB9P/F-DB25P/M, 3C+1, Grey, 2m, (OEM)"); its P/N block reads "DB25M/DB9F-3C+1, 2000+/-50MM" (7/0.12CCS x 3C+1, OD 4.40mm) with no LS code. LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M is a different build (6C+1, 1.8 m, white-grey, drawing QJ/XYT-A201200). Same connector pair does not make them the same product — the supplier keeps two drawings because they are two products. Existing KB entries for sha1 ff3b196aa59976911d847ea50638022990a7d85d reach the same conclusion three times independently, one at high confidence noting BOR's serial-cable quotation lists this 2 m 3C+1 row with a BLANK item number.

(2) PIN MAP DIFFERS. Kyu 2022-12-05: "This cables pin map is different other cables." And in Dec 2021 (INBOX:6094/6115) Kyu and Gu argue specifically about the LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M pin map — i.e. 9F25M's pin map is a separate, contested spec, not the OEM cable's.

(3) THE DOCUMENT HAS ZERO PRODUCT SPECIFICITY. The byte-identical file (verified by shasum: attachments_raw/INBOX_4247, INBOX_5014, INBOX_5210 all = df4ca43b...) was also sent on 2021-08-13 as the RoHS pack for VGA cables in reply to "we need the ROHS2 sheet for LS-SRGB-15MM-Xm", and again 2021-09-03 with Gu writing "Actually serial cable material is same as VGA cable material." Gu's covering line in the rs232 mail itself — "SGS test report for materials. Actually all products are compliant with RoHS now" — confirms it is BOR's shared BOM dossier (11 sheets: AL foil, CCA, copper, PVC, PBT, brass, nickel, screw, SPCC, HDPE, Al-Mg wire). Every BOR foil-shielded cable is covered. The claim's uniqueness argument ("exactly one family is a DB9F-DB25M serial cable") therefore proves nothing: LS-SER-9FF, 9MF, 9MM, 9MFC, 25MF, 25MM (all "알루미늄 포일 + PVC 자켓, CCS" per family_catalog.json) and LS-SRGB fit equally well.

(4) CONSISTENCY. The other 10 attachments of the identical 2021-05-07 mail (Brass H62, CCA, Copper Wire, PVC, PBT, Screw, SPCC, HDPE, Nickel, Al-alloy wire) are all recorded unresolved with models=[] for exactly this reason. Singling this one out is arbitrary.

NO INFORMATION IS LOST BY REJECTING: sha1 df4ca43b is already resolved in kb_docs.json under models LS-SRGB-15MM-XM, LS-SER-9MF-XXM, 9MM, 9FF, 9MFC, 25MF, 25MM via the better-anchored INBOX:5014/5210 threads where Kyu actually names a model. Attaching LS-SER-9F25M from this thread would only inject the false identity "OEM 3C+1 2m cable = LS-SER-9F25M" into the chatbot.

REFUTATION 1 - the identical file is a shared, product-agnostic material sheet. sha1 9f7d594b… / 718786 bytes is attached BYTE-IDENTICALLY to three different BOR mails (bodies.json attachment sha1s): INBOX:4247 2021-05-07 "rs232 cable (OEM)"; INBOX:5014 2021-08-13 "Re: ROHS2" where Gu writes "Please find attached SGS test report of ROHS for VGA cables!" in reply to kyu's "we need the ROHS2 sheet for LS-SRGB-15MM-Xm)"; INBOX:5210 2021-09-03 "Re: Serial cable ROHS sheet" where Gu writes "Actually serial cable material is same as VGA cable marerial." The archive's own enrichment already carries this exact sha1 as kind="resolved" with current_models ["LS-SRGB-15MM-XM"] (enrich/e_091.json) — i.e. a VGA family, not a serial one. A cert that the supplier ships verbatim for VGA cables, serial cables and an OEM RS232 cable cannot be pinned to one serial family.

REFUTATION 2 - the certificate names no product at all. document_text contains zero occurrences of VGA, RS232, serial, cable, 型号, Model or 规格. It is only 样品名称 螺丝 / "screw", 材料 快销钢 "Fast pin steel", applicant 慈溪市观海卫忠图五金配件厂 (a generic hardware-fittings factory), CTI Ningbo A2200361163101004E, testing only Pb/Cd/Hg/Cr(VI). Nothing in it distinguishes a D-sub thumbscrew from any other screw. The packet's own title_ko even calls it "VGA 커넥터용 나사", contradicting the serial-cable claim.

REFUTATION 3 - the catalogue match is not unique; a dozen families fit equally well. family_catalog_short.json contains LS-SER-9FF, LS-SER-9MF, LS-SER-9MFC, LS-SER-9MM, LS-SER-25MF, LS-SER-25MM, LS-PRT-25C / LS-PRT-25C-XX, LS-GEN-DB9FF, LS-CON-S15F, LS-CON-S15M, LS-RGB-15MM and LS-SRGB-15MM — all BOR/Xinya D-sub assemblies using the same connector hardware. LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M has no privileged claim; LS-SRGB-15MM-XM actually has a stronger one (explicit "for VGA cables" cover letter).

REFUTATION 4 - product identity is wrong inside the mail itself. Kyu 2022-12-05 specifies "DB9P/F-DB25P/M, 3C+1, Grey, 2m, (OEM)", "PE BAG" / "pack with PE bag without sticker", and states "This cables pin map is different other cables." The catalogue LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M is 6C+1, OD 4.0-4.40 mm, 1.8 m, white-grey mould, drawing QJ/XYT-A201200. Different conductor count, length, pin map and branding — an unbranded OEM SKU Lanstar deliberately never gave a model code.

CONSISTENCY - the two sibling documents in the same packet from the same 11-attachment material pack (C2680-ROHS d93ccd60, COPPER WIRE-ROHS 261433ec) were already rejected by a prior pass on exactly these grounds, their previous_reason noting the sheets are "also reused in VGA-cable and USB-connector RoHS packs INBOX:8658/7400/6948/5014" and that "the claimed LS-SER-*-XXM codes were borrowed from a different thread's data-sheet filenames … so no model is honestly determinable."

CONCLUSION - a customer-facing bot must not return this screw report for LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M. It is a line-wide component sheet attached to an OEM item with no Lanstar code. models=[], families=[].

title_ko: Fluke DSX-8000 채널 시험성적서 — LS-SSTP-CAT.7-100M (Cat 7 S/FTP), ISO11801 Channel Class Ea(+All) PASS, 2022-10-27 시험 (구 보관 자료)
scope_target: LS-SSTP-CAT.7-100M S/FTP Cat.7 랜케이블 완제품 (334ft 채널 시험)
caveat_ko: 세 가지를 반드시 함께 안내해야 합니다. (1) 시험일이 2022-10-27인 과거 보관 자료로, 공급사(Bor)가 '최근 발주가 없어 재고가 없고 재시험이 불가하다'며 옛 성적서를 보내온 것입니다. (2) 적용 시험규격이 ISO11801 Channel Class Ea(= Cat.6A 채널 등급)로, Cat.7에 해당하는 Class F/FA 기준으로 시험된 성적서가 아닙니다. (3) 측정 길이가 334ft로 채널 한계 328ft를 초과 표기되어 있습니다. 고객이 Cat.7 규격 성적서를 요구하는 경우 이 파일만 단독 제공하면 이의가 제기될 수 있습니다.
product_in_doc: Cable ID: LS-SSTP-CAT.7-100M / Cable Type: Cat 7 S/FTP
key_specs: 판정 PASS; 시험한계 ISO11801 Channel Class Ea(+All); 헤드룸 17.5dB (NEXT 1,2-3,6); 길이 334ft(약 102m, 표시 한계 328ft); 전파지연 437ns; 지연스큐 2ns; 루프저항 14.10Ω(한계 25Ω); 저항 불평형 0.302Ω(한계 0.420); 삽입손실 마진 7.2dB @500MHz; NVP 78.0%; TCL 25.9dB·CDNEXT 46.2dB·ELTCTL 6.7dB 측정 포함; Wire Map T568B PASS; 장비 Fluke Versiv DSX-8000 + DSX-CHA804, LinkWare PC v10.7

sources.subject: ROHS for cable
sources.evidence:
CITED EVIDENCE VERIFIED. retry_packets/r_013.json doc[1] = sha1 c8b39f98, "Copper Wire-ROHS.pdf", thread INBOX:7401 (guzhiyi@bor-cable.com -> kyu, 2022-06-10, "ROHS for cable"). Body quote is verbatim: "Now I send the SGS report of USB 2.0 cable. USB 2.0 Cable material is easy, including conductor(copper wire), insulation(HDPE), shielding 1(Al-Mylar), shielding 2(ALMG braiding), jacket(PVC)". attach_map.json INBOX:7401 confirms exactly 5 attachments matching those 5 materials. Report content = 裸铜线 (bare copper wire), CTI Suzhou A2220022330101001C, 2022-01-20, applicant 新协基电子(常熟)有限公司 — i.e. the CONDUCTOR raw-material report of BOR's USB 2.0 cable.

EXTRA CORROBORATION (not in the claim). doc_text.json BOR drawings for the plain USB 2.0 families all carry MATERIAL LIST = JACKET / INSULATION / BRAID / CONDUCTOR / AL-FOIL and the identical cable spec "USB 2.0 CABLE, 7/0.12BC*1P+7/0.12BC*2C+AL+48/0.12ALMG+PVC": LS-USB-AMAF-xxM.pdf (4c68f677bf, 2021-08-18, OD4.5 grey), LS-USB-AMAM-xxM.pdf (801fe65d08, 2021-08-18), LS-USB-AMBM-xxM.pdf (c46180a35d, 2021-08-18 — the claim asserted this family without citing the drawing; it does exist and matches), LS-USB MINI 5P-xM.pdf (6ced2e3cde, 2020-04-08 = internal code LS-USB-AM5P, OD4.0 black). Five materials map 1:1 onto the five attachments, and BC = bare copper matches 裸铜线. Supporting order context: Sent:2637 (2022-06-17, one week later) orders LS-USB-AM5P-1M/2M/3M.

DISCRIMINATION HOLDS vs other product types. This sha1 appears only in INBOX:7401 (grep across scratchpad; doc_text.json shows 4 distinct copper-wire PDFs with different sha1s). BOR sent DIFFERENT conductor reports for LAN products — CCA-ROHS-2022.pdf (495ac714) for LS-5SFTP-300M/LS-6SFTP-300M, Bare Copper Wire-ROHS-2022.pdf (aea8455e) for LS-5FTPSD-BKxM. USB 3.0 families are correctly excluded: LS-USB3.0-AMAF/AMAM/AMBM/AMMIC 2020 drawings specify 7/0.20TC + 7/0.12TC (TINNED copper) and 96/128-0.12 ALMG, not the pure-BC 48/0.12 build.

REFUTATION — ONE CLAIMED FAMILY IS WRONG. LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM (and its duplicate catalogue key USB2.0-AMAF-S1M) is the SCREW version, and the supplier rules this substitution out in writing. INBOX:12843, Gu -> kyu, 2023-11-17, replying to kyu's direct question "Is it possible to apply that RoHS sheet to the USB-AMAF-S1M cable? (Screw USB cable)": "USB Screw Cable is designed for a wider range than normal USB cable... So the ROHS of normal USB cable is not suitable for USB screw cables. on the contrary, the ROHS of USB screw cable is suitable for normal USB cable. That's why we made the ROHS specially for USB screw cable". INBOX:7401 is the normal-USB-cable set, so it does not cover the screw family. Independently, LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM already has its own dedicated material set from INBOX:3885 (2021-03-23, subject "ROHS - USB screw cable", kyu explicitly names LS-USB2.0-AMAF-sXm): copper.PDF (61cacb522a) is its conductor report, plus Al Foil-RoHS.pdf (41b4f848d5), HDPE-ROHS.PDF (49f6ef6f34), PVC-ROHS.pdf (7ddcc0eef5), Al-Mg alloy wire.pdf (a93827c433). The claim was also internally inconsistent: it listed LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM but omitted USB2.0-AMAF-S1M, which family_catalog.json carries as a separate key for the same product.

OTHER FAMILIES CORRECTLY EXCLUDED. LSP-EC-USB2A is a keystone wall-plate coupler with no cable/conductor. LSP-EC-USB3A, LS-USB3.0-*, LS-U3AOC* are not USB 2.0 copper patch cables of this build.

RESIDUAL CAVEAT (why medium, not high). No LS/LSP/ZOT/LSN code appears anywhere in INBOX:7401 — the request was generic ("test report or COC (CE) report about USB2.0 cable"). BOR recycles these raw-material PDFs across unrelated products: the four sibling attachments of this same mail (AL-Mylar 994ab8ea, HDPE 757538761d, PVC 18f10e67e3, ALMG cb7707e156) were re-sent 10 days later in INBOX:7475 "300M Roll - RoHS" and resolved to LS-5SFTP-300M/LS-6SFTP-300M. So this is a generic component certificate whose only product anchor is the thread; family level is the honest ceiling and no single model can be picked. Chatbot guidance: deliver only as one of the 5 raw-material reports constituting the BOR plain USB 2.0 cable, never alone as a finished-product RoHS, and never for the screw (S/SxM) variants. [검증-수정]

sources.subject: ROHS for USB connector
sources.evidence: 스레드(2022-06-10, guzhiyi@bor-cable.com → kyu@lanstar.co.kr, 제목 'ROHS for USB connector')에서 kyu가 'We need test report or COC (CE) report about USB2.0 cable'라고 요청 → GU가 'As for USB 2.0 cable, we have not done CE report! Only SGS test report(RoHS) for materials' → 'Now I send the SGS test report of USB connector only... all these for connector only!'라며 본 첨부(8건)를 송부. 즉 문서는 BOR가 랜스타에 공급하는 USB 2.0 케이블의 커넥터 원자재 RoHS 자료임이 스레드로 확정되나, 스레드·문서 어디에도 LS/LSP 코드는 없음(재확인: 문서 텍스트 내 LS- 정규식 매칭 0건). 랜스타 코드는 카탈로그에서 'BOR 공급 USB 2.0 케이블' 제품군으로만 좁혀짐 — LS-USB-AMAF(USB2.0 A수-A암, BOR 도면 2021-08-18), LS-USB-AMAM(A수-A수, 동일 도면), LS-USB-AMBM(A수-B수), LS-USB-AM5P(A수-Mini B 5P, BOR 도면 2020-04-08), LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM(나사고정형 USB2.0 연장). 보강 근거: 같은 아카이브의 별도 BOR 메일(2021-08-18, 'Please find the data sheet for all USB 2.0 cables!')에 LS-USB-AMAF-xxM.pdf / LS-USB-AMAM-xxM.pdf / LS-USB-AMBM-xxM.pdf 3종이 첨부되어 BOR가 정의하는 'USB 2.0 케이블 전 제품'의 범위를 확인해 줌. 다만 이 시험성적서 자체가 특정 모델을 지정하지 않으므로 단일 패밀리로 좁힐 수 없음. [검증완료]

sources.subject: ROHS for USB connector
sources.evidence: 인용 근거는 실재하나 범위가 1건 과다하여 revise. (1) INBOX:7400(2022-06-10) 원문 확인: kyu 'USB2.0 cable' 요청 → GU 'all these for connector only'로 C2680-ROSH.pdf 포함 8건 송부. (2) 인용된 INBOX:5040(2021-08-18) 실재 확인 — 'data sheet for all USB 2.0 cables' 첨부는 LS-USB-AMAF-xxM / LS-USB-AMAM-xxM / LS-USB-AMBM-xxM 3건뿐이며 AM5P·screw는 미포함. (3) 신규 결정적 근거: 동일 sha1이 INBOX:6948(2022-04-14 'ROHS of USB connectors part-1')에서 최초 송부되었고, 이는 kyu 2022-04-13 '기존 USB cable ROHS sheet 2019ver의 최신판 요청'에 대한 답신. 아카이브 내 유일한 2019버전 USB RoHS 세트는 INBOX:3884/3885(2021-03-23)로, kyu가 명시적으로 'ROHS sheet for LS-USB2.0-AMAF-sXm series'를 요청해 받은 세트(2018-12~2019-06 발행 PBT NC/BK·금/니켈/동/주석 도금·SPCC 철쉘). 즉 본 2022년 세트는 스크류 케이블 커넥터 자료의 갱신판이므로 LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM은 유지 타당. (4) 오염 배제: VGA/시리얼 케이블용 C2680-ROHS.PDF는 sha1 d93ccd60fb…로 별개 파일이며, 본 sha1은 USB 커넥터 메일 2건에만 등장. USB 3.0 계열은 스레드가 'USB 2.0'으로 한정하므로 제외. (5) 제외 사유 — LS-USB-AM5P: 'all USB 2.0 cables' 열거에 미포함, 데이터시트·RoHS 모두 별도 라인으로 취급(INBOX:6941, INBOX:8228), 커넥터 형상이 Mini-B 5P로 상이하고 INBOX:8228은 PVC 자켓/몰딩 3건만 다룸 → 본 커넥터 소재(C2680 황동·SPCC·SUS301·PBT)와의 연결 근거 전무. LSP-EC-USB2A(어댑터, 자체 RoHS 보유)도 '케이블' 요청 범위 밖. 주의: 본 문서는 완제품 인증서가 아닌 커넥터용 황동 판재 원자재 RoHS이므로 제공 시 scope(raw_material) 명시 필요. [검증-수정]

sources.subject: ROHS for USB connector
sources.evidence:
CITED EVIDENCE VERIFIED, SET INCOMPLETE. The mail and quoted history are exactly as claimed (bodies.json INBOX:7400, 2022-06-10 08:03, guzhiyi@bor-cable.com: "So many SGS test report for USB 2.0 cable, Now I send the SGS test report of USB connector only... all these for connector only!", replying to kyu's "We need test report or COC (CE) report about USB2.0 cable"). The doc is SGS CANEC2119011820 on "PBT BK" / Model No. "Bogen PBT" from PLT (Guangdong) Technology — scope raw_material (black plastic grains, connector housing resin). No Lanstar code in the document or thread, so only a category link is possible; that part of the claim is sound.

REFUTATION OF THE SPECIFIC SET: (1) The identical sha1 also appears as "PBT BK-1-ROHS.pdf" in INBOX:6948 (2022-04-14, "ROHS of USB connectors part-1"), answering kyu's 2022-04-13 "We have USB cable ROHS sheet 2019ver. Our customer requested the newest ROHS Sheet." So this is BOR's generic USB-connector material file, re-sent for any USB request — it is not tied to any one family by the document. (2) INBOX:5040 (2021-08-18) is decisive on scope: BOR writes "Please find the data sheet for all USB 2.0 cables!" and attaches exactly LS-USB-AMAF-xxM.pdf, LS-USB-AMAM-xxM.pdf and LS-USB-AMBM-xxM.pdf, in reply to kyu's Sent:1713 request naming LS-USB-AMBM-0.5M. LS-USB-AMBM is therefore co-equal with AMAM and AMAF (same supplier, same mail, same product class, same USB-A/B connector using the same PBT insert); the claim's exclusion of it is arbitrary. final_data.json confirms LS-USB-AMBM as a live BOR family (doc c46180a35d, members LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M / -XXM).

COMPETING HYPOTHESIS TESTED AND REJECTED: the screw-cable families (LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM / USB2.0-AMAF-S1M / -S5M) own the 2019-vintage predecessor bundle that this 2021 set updates (INBOX:3884, 2021-03-23 "ROHS - USB screw cable", kyu naming LS-USB2.0-AMAF-sXm, attachments 白胶芯-PBT NC-20181225 / 黑胶芯-PBT BK-20190103, resolved to LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM). But BOR themselves rule out cross-application in INBOX:12843 (2023-11-17): "the ROHS of normal USB cable is not suitable for USB screw cables. On the contrary, the ROHS of USB screw cable is suitable for normal USB cable." The 2022-06-10 request is plain "USB2.0 cable" (normal), so screw families are excluded.

LS-USB-AM5P retained (BOR USB 2.0 A/M-Mini B 5P, drawing 2020-04-08, doc 6ced2e3cde) but it is the weakest member: BOR consistently calls it "USB mini 5p" separately and its own RoHS thread (Sep-Oct 2022) covers PVC only. The bundle's SUS301 report is however characteristic of Mini-B shells, and the A-male end uses the same SPCC/C2680/PBT/plating set, so the raw-material link holds.

Precedent check: sibling raw-material reports from this same supplier are routinely reused across unrelated products (SPCC-ROHS.pdf appears under VGA LS-HRGB-15MM-XM and PS2 LS-PS2-6MM-1.8M threads), confirming these files are material-level and must be linked by the thread's product, not by the document. [검증-수정]

sources.subject: ROHS for USB connector
sources.evidence:
EVIDENCE CHECK — all cited text is real and quoted correctly. r_015.json holds the doc; the thread (INBOX:7400, GU guzhiyi@bor-cable.com -> kyu, 2022-06-10, "ROHS for USB connector") contains verbatim: kyu "We need test report or COC (CE) report about USB2.0 cable", Gu "As for USB 2.0 cable, we have not done CE report! Only SGS test report(RoHS) for materials", and "Now I send the SGS test report of USB connector only... all these for connector only!" with 8 material PDFs incl. SPCC-ROHS.pdf. Document itself (CTI A2210165952101001, 2021-05-12, applicant Dongguan Jukang Hardware Materials) names only "Sample Name: SPCC / Silver-gray metal" — no product, no LS code. Product-type match is genuine: SPCC cold-rolled steel is the USB-A plug shell material, and the supplier explicitly scopes the whole attachment set to the USB 2.0 cable's connector. So the link direction is sound.

WHY REVISE — the family set is under-inclusive, not wrong. The claim asserts the BOR USB 2.0 cable line is exactly {AMAM, AMAF, AM5P}. The archive refutes that. INBOX:5040 (Gu, 2021-08-18): "Please find the data sheet for all USB 2.0 cables!" — attachments are LS-USB-AMAF-xxM.pdf, LS-USB-AMAM-xxM.pdf, LS-USB-AMBM-xxM.pdf (attach_map.json). LS-USB-AMBM is therefore a BOR USB 2.0 cable family on exactly the same footing as the two the claim accepted; family_catalog.json carries "USB 2.0 A/M to B/M CABLE — 모델 LS-USB-AMBM-", and final_data.json members_of has LS-USB-AMBM = [LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M, LS-USB-AMBM-XXM]. Its USB-A plug shell is the very SPCC part this report covers, so the claim's own rationale ("the USB A connector is common to all three") applies to it identically. Omitting it is arbitrary. LS-USB-AM5P is independently confirmed as BOR USB 2.0: INBOX:8152 names "LS-USB-AM5P-1.5M" as BOR's "USB mini 5p cable", and INBOX:6941 delivered LS-USB MINI 5P-xM.pdf against kyu's request naming LS-USB-AM5P-Xm.

BOUNDARY CHECKS (why not broader) — (1) Screw families LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM / USB2.0-AMAF-S1M are excluded by the supplier's own rule, INBOX:12843 (2023-11-17): "the ROHS of normal USB cable is not suitable for USB screw cables... on the contrary, the ROHS of USB screw cable is suitable for normal USB cable" — the implication runs the wrong way for this document. (2) USB 3.0 families (LS-USB3.0-*, LS-EXT3xx, LS-U30*) are excluded: the request and reply both say USB 2.0, the 3.0 connector is a different part, and USB 3.0 RoHS/CE is handled on a separate track (INBOX:18909, 2025-02-13, different maker SCPL). (3) LSP-EC-USB2A keystone wall-plate adaptor is a USB 2.0 A(F) connector product but not a cable, outside the mail's stated scope; left out.

CAVEATS the chatbot should honour — this is a raw_material report, not a finished-product certificate; it certifies the connector shell steel only, and cannot be presented as RoHS proof for a complete cable. The same file (sha1 99ae9b…) was also sent as INBOX:6949 (2022-04-14, "ROHS of USB connectors part-2") against another generic "USB cable ROHS" request, confirming it is BOR's standard connector-material document rather than a per-model one. Note also that two other, distinct SPCC-ROHS.pdf files exist in the corpus (sha1 fdb8f31e… -> LS-HRGB-15MM-XM/LS-SRGB-15MM-XM VGA; sha1 03be7c8c… -> LS-PS2-6MM-1.8M) — filename alone must never be used for retrieval, only sha1. [검증-수정]

sources.evidence: Cited evidence is real but the catalogue premise is false. VERIFIED: mail INBOX:7400 (guzhiyi@bor-cable.com -> kyu, 2022-06-10, "ROHS for USB connector") has exactly the 8 attachments listed, including SUS301-ROHS.pdf = this sha1; body verbatim "Now I send the SGS test report of USB connector only... all these for connector only!"; kyu's request was generic "test report or COC (CE) report about USB2.0 cable"; report applicant is DONGGUAN JUKANG HARDWARE MATERIALS, sample name only "SUS301 / Silvery metal", report A2210350966102001, 2021-08-31, PASS. No LS/LSP code anywhere in the thread. REFUTATION 1: the claim states "The catalogue's BOR USB 2.0 cable families are LS-USB-AMAM, LS-USB-AMAF and LS-USB-AM5P" — false. family_catalog.json also holds LS-USB-AMBM ("USB 2.0 A/M to B/M CABLE", members LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M / LS-USB-AMBM-XXM). Mail INBOX:5040 (2021-08-18), in which Gu says he is sending data sheets "for all USB 2.0 cables", attaches precisely LS-USB-AMAF-xxM.pdf, LS-USB-AMAM-xxM.pdf AND LS-USB-AMBM-xxM.pdf — the supplier's own scope of "all USB 2.0 cables" includes AMBM, so excluding it while including AM5P is arbitrary. REFUTATION 2: the same sha1 is also an attachment of INBOX:6949 (2022-04-14, "ROHS of USB connectors part-2"), which answers kyu 2022-04-13 "We have USB cable ROHS sheet 2019ver. Our customer requested the newest ROHS Sheet". That 2019 set is INBOX:3884 (gold/nickel/copper plating, tin, SPCC iron shell, PBT NC/BK), already assigned in final_data.json to LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM (BOR USB 2.0 screw-lock A male/female cable). The 2022 set (bright-tin/gold/nickel plating, C2680 brass, SPCC, SUS301, halogen-free PBT BK/NC) is the same connector-material family one generation newer, so LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM has a stronger, model-named provenance than any of the three claimed families and must not be dropped. (Catalogue also carries the sibling key USB2.0-AMAF-S1M for the same screw series; it is non-LS so it is not listed separately.) SCOPE LIMITS KEPT: USB 3.0 families (LS-USB3.0-AMAM/AMAF/AMBM/AMMIC, LS-U3AOC*) are excluded because both mails say USB 2.0; LSP-EC-USB2A is excluded because it is a keystone wall-plate adaptor, not a cable, and has its own distinct material set (LSP-EC-USB2A-ROHS.rar: FR-4, ABS, Au plating, phosphor copper). WEAKNESS ACKNOWLEDGED: this is a category-level link only — the report identifies no connector type, and BOR reuses such raw-material reports widely (the sibling mail INBOX:7401 of this very thread contains cable-material reports that the corpus resolved to LS-5SFTP-300M / LS-5FTPSD-BKXM, unrelated to USB). Hence medium confidence and the broader BOR USB 2.0 family set rather than a narrow three. [검증-수정]

sources.subject: ROHS for USB connector
sources.evidence:
Cited mail exists and is quoted correctly: INBOX:7400 (2022-06-10, guzhiyi@bor-cable.com -> kyu, "ROHS for USB connector", 8 attachments incl. 无卤PBT NC-ROHS.pdf = SGS CANEC2119011813 / Job CP21-054325-GZ, 2021-10-26, sample "PBT NC / White plastic grains", Model No. "Bogen PBT", client PLT (GUANGDONG) TECHNOLOGY). Gu: "all these for connector only!"; no Lanstar code anywhere in the thread or the PDF. So the doc is a raw-material RoHS for the insulator resin of BOR's USB 2.0 connectors — a category-level link is honest, but the claim's specific family set is not.

REFUTATION 1 — LS-USB-AM5P does not belong. BOR treats Mini B 5P as a separate line: separate data-sheet thread (INBOX:6941, 2022-04-13 "Data sheet about USB Mini 5p"), and in the dedicated Mini-5P RoHS thread three months AFTER this mail (Sent:2883 2022-09-15 / INBOX:8228 2022-09-26) Gu supplied a completely different material package — PVC jacket / PVC cable jacket / PVC molding only — never this PBT connector set. That thread exists because LS-USB-AM5P-1.5M (20,000 pcs) FAILED a Korean RoHS test at Lanstar's customer. Handing this connector-resin report to an AM5P customer is precisely the wrong-certificate risk the review is meant to prevent.

REFUTATION 2 — LS-USB-AMBM is missing though it is a peer of the two kept families. INBOX:5040 (2021-08-18): Gu writes "Please find the data sheet for all USB 2.0 cables!" and attaches exactly LS-USB-AMAF-xxM.pdf, LS-USB-AMAM-xxM.pdf, LS-USB-AMBM-xxM.pdf. That is BOR's own definition of the USB 2.0 cable group; excluding AMBM while including AMAM/AMAF is arbitrary (AMBM data sheet resent INBOX:9749, 2023-03-07).

REFUTATION 3 — LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM (screw-type USB 2.0 A/M-A/F, incl. USB2.0-AMAF-S1M) has the strongest documented link and was omitted. The request that produced this document (INBOX:6948, 2022-04-13, quoted by kyu) says: "We have USB cable ROHS sheet 2019ver. Our customer requested the newest ROHS Sheet, not the 2019ver". The 2019 sheet set in Lanstar's hands is INBOX:3884/3885 ("ROHS - USB screw cable", 2021-03-23) requested by Sent:1181 "We need ROHS sheet for LS-USB2.0-AMAF-sXm series". Its 白胶芯-PBT NC（ROHS）-20181225.PDF (sha1 9902f711) is the SAME resin from the SAME maker — SGS Guangzhou, Model No. "Bogen PBT", Client Ref. sources.evidence:
REFUTED ITEM — LS-EXT3XX must be dropped. The claim's only support for it is the packet's own previous_reason ("kyu re-sent this file in the Feb-2025 LS-EXT3xx thread as the 'normal ROHS sheet'"). I pulled that thread from bodies.json and it says the opposite of what the claim implies. Sent:5643 (2025-02-13, attachment_names = exactly "Male-female cable RoHS-Certification 20230109.pdf"): kyu ASKS "Could you please send ROHS sheet for LS-EXT3xx series? we have normal ROHS sheet... Does the USB3.0 repeater cable also fall under the ROHS sheet attached?" The supplier's reply INBOX:18909 (same day) answers NO: "SCPL has CE certificate for USB 3.0 repeater cable, but no ROHS certificate. If your guests don't know very well, you can replace the USB 3.0 repeater cable ROHS report with the regular USB 3.0 extension cable ROHS report." So kyu's re-send was a question, and the answer was an explicit admission that no RoHS exists for LS-EXT3xx plus a suggestion to fudge it. Two independent grounds also kill it: (a) different manufacturer — this cert's manufacturer is Ningbo Borland Electronic Co., Ltd (Xiangshan BOR), whereas LS-EXT3XX's own CE cert (sha 27c28ef5da, HUAK HK2205272272E) names holder/manufacturer Ningbo SCPL Electronic Co., Ltd; (b) different construction — LS-EXT305/310/315/320 datasheets describe an ACTIVE repeater cable with embedded VL210 ICs, not a passive M-F assembly. Handing a LS-EXT3xx customer this file is precisely the "wrong product's certificate" failure mode.

VERIFIED ITEMS — the rest of the claim holds, and is better supported than the claim itself argued. The certificate is not a generic catalogue guess: final_data.json's docs record for this sha1 already carries models [LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM, LS-5FTPSD-BKXM, LS-7SD-BKXM, LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M, USB2.0-AMAF-S1M] from five other threads where the same PDF was sent with direct model naming: INBOX:9144 (2023-01-09, "We get the ROHS certificate of ALL screws cables", answering kyu's 2022-11-30 request for LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SxM); INBOX:11509 (2023-07-28, kyu asks for LS-5FTPSD-BKxM, Gu: "including all of your screws cables"); INBOX:22752 (2025-09-30, Gu: "We issued ROHS certificates for all SCREW CABLES in 2023, it's including the LS-7SD-BKxM"); INBOX:12843 (2023-11-17, kyu names USB2.0-AMAF-S1M); INBOX:27457 (2026-07-08, request lists LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M). The five catalogue keys the claim cites do exist verbatim in family_catalog_short.json, and LS-7SD-BK / LS-DPMF-SXM / LS-USB-AMAF / LS-USB3.0-AMAF datasheet lines are quoted accurately.

The claim's two "type-only" additions are actually backed by supplier statements, not just catalogue matching. INBOX:12843 (2023-11-17) states the governing rule: "the ROHS of normal USB cable is not suitable for USB screw cables. On the contrary, the ROHS of USB screw cable is suitable for normal USB cable." That licenses LS-USB-AMAF (BOR USB2.0 A/M-A/F, sha 4c68f677) and LS-USB3.0-AMAF (BOR USB3.0 A M/A F, sha 31145f04 / ccf8e2ef) — both literally named in the cert scope ("USB 2.0 male/female cable", "USB 3.0 male/female cable"), same manufacturer, and neither has any competing finished-product RoHS in the archive. Gu's own Feb-2025 wording "the regular USB 3.0 extension cable ROHS report" refers to this very file. LS-DPMF-SXM likewise: its datasheet (sha a340ca97, Xiangshan BOR, 2020-07-20) is "DP 1.2 M-F CABLE, LS-DPMF-S0.5M~S3M, P1 DP female panel-mount with M3x12mm screws supplied, P2 DP male" — i.e. a screw/panel DisplayPort male-female cable, exactly the cert's "DisplayPort male/female cable" line, from the same maker, with no competing RoHS.

UNIQUENESS CHECK — no rival family fits better. The cert's other scope lines are already routed elsewhere: HDMI male/female = LS-HDMI-HMF, which has its own BCTC RoHS (sha aad34858, BCTC2003002134R). LS-DPFF-S0.2M is female-female, outside "male/female". LS-USB-AMAM / LS-USB3.0-AMAM / LS-USB3.0-AMBM are male-male and are not covered. Corroborating the "screw cable family" grouping, SGS report 09ce016c (zinc-plated fixing SCREW raw material) is attached to exactly LS-5FTPSD-BKXM + LS-7SD-BKXM + LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM.

RESTORED — the claim silently dropped USB2.0-AMAF-S1M and LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M, which have stronger (direct, named-in-mail) evidence than the two families the claim added. I put them back. LS-USB-AMBM is A-male-to-B-male, so it is outside the cert's literal wording; it stands only on Gu's 2026-07-08 "useful for all USB cables" plus the 2023 screw-covers-normal principle — flag it as supplier-asserted coverage when serving it. sources.evidence:
The link is real and far better supported than the packet shows, but LS-EXT3XX must be dropped. The packet only carried the Aug-2024 thread; this exact sha1 was mailed by BOR six times (found via bodies.json in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-lanstar-mail2/752f8fc5-be77-4ab5-bb66-347588e328d1/scratchpad/bodies.json), and three of those mails name Lanstar codes explicitly — so this is no longer a catalogue-similarity guess.

DIRECT MAIL EVIDENCE (attachment sha1 8a0fd76… present in each):
1. INBOX:9144, 2023-01-09, subject "CE certificate about Screw cable" — Gu: "We get the ROHS certificate of ALL screws cables, Please find attached files". The quoted thread has Kyu asking RoHS for "1. LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SxM 2. LS-DP192-xM" and Gu answering "As for item LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SxM, USB screw cables, we will start to make RoHS today… about 2 weeks." This document (tested 2022-12-07~13, issued 2023-01-09) IS that RoHS. LS-DP192 was answered with a different sheet, so it is not covered here.
2. INBOX:11509, 2023-07-28 — Kyu: "could you please send ROHS sheet for LS-5FTPSD-BKxM?"; Gu attaches these two PDFs: "ROHS certificate and ROHS test report including all of your screws cables."
3. INBOX:22752, 2025-09-30 — Gu: "We issued ROHS certificates for all SCREW CABLES in 2023, it's including the LS-7SD-BKxM, please see attached file."
4. INBOX:12843, 2023-11-17 — Kyu asks about USB2.0-AMAF-S1M (screw USB); Gu: "we made the ROHS specially for USB screw cable… the ROHS of USB screw cable is suitable for normal USB cable" (this is the basis for keeping the non-screw LS-USB-AMAF / LS-USB3.0-AMAF).

PRODUCT-TYPE CHECK: BOR's own "Screw Cables.xlsx" quotation (doc_text.json, attachments_raw/INBOX_5230 and INBOX_11661) defines the screw range item-by-item: F/UTP Cat.5e M-F = LS-5FTPSD-BK0.2M~5M; S/FTP Cat.6A/7 M-F = LS-7SD-BK0.2M~5M; USB2.0 A M-A F = LS-USB2.0-AMAF-S0.5M~S5M; USB3.0 A M-A F = LS-USB30-S1M/S2M; DP1.2 M-F = LS-DPMF-S0.5M~S2M. That maps one-to-one onto the report's scope "USB 2.0 / USB 3.0 / RJ45 / DisplayPort male-female cable". LS-USB-AMAF shares the identical bulk cable with the screw version (7/0.12BC*1P+7/0.16BC*2C+AL+ALMG braid+PVC, OD 4.5 mm, grey, same jacket print), and LS-USB3.0-AMAF likewise (OD 5.5 mm blue) — consistent with the report's "Blue plastic"/"Grey" sample rows. No competing family fits: the catalogue's only other M-F candidates are the F-F screw variants and LS-HDMI-HMF, and LS-HDMI-HMF is a Changzhou Vnew (VN-HD01) product, not BOR.

WHY LS-EXT3XX IS REFUTED: in the Feb-2025 thread (Sent:5643 → INBOX:18909) Kyu asks "Does the USB3.0 repeater cable also fall under the ROHS sheet attached?" and Gu answers "SCPL has CE certificate for USB 3.0 repeater cable, but no ROHS certificate. If your guests don't know very well, you can replace the USB 3.0 repeater cable ROHS report with the regular USB 3.0 extension cable ROHS report." That is an explicit statement that LS-EXT3xx has NO RoHS of record — the sheet is only a substitute to show customers who don't check. Gu then attached the repeater's own docs (USB_5G_ EXTENSION CABLE 5M-CE-EMC 证书/Test report, HUAK). LS-EXT3xx is also an active cable with repeater ICs, PCBs, LEDs and a bundled adapter, materials this passive-cable report never sampled. Additionally, the cited evidence is factually wrong for this sha1: Kyu's Feb-2025 mail attached only "Male-female cable RoHS-Certification 20230109.pdf" (7dba9d16…, the C document) — this R report was not in it.

OTHER CORRECTIONS: the claim's catalogue argument is partly circular — keys LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM, USB2.0-AMAF-S1M, LS-7SD-BKXM, LS-5FTPSD-BKXM and LS-USB-AMBM in family_catalog.json carry this document's own description as their text, i.e. they exist because of a prior pass, not independently. That prior pass also attached these docs to LS-USB-AMBM (USB 2.0 A-male to B-male), which is male-to-male and outside the certificate's scope; the claim correctly omitted it and I keep it omitted (Gu did offer the file for LS-USB-AMBM-1.8M in INBOX:27457, 2026-07-08, but only as "useful for all USB cables"). Family list normalised: the claim mixed LS-7SD-BK with LS-5FTPSD-BKXM; both catalogue key spellings for the Cat.6A/7 family are included. Not added, but worth noting as a possible extension: the same "all screw cables" cover letter would also cover the F-F variants LS-USB2.0-FFS0.2M, LS-5FTPSD-FF0.2M, LS-7SD-FF0.2M and LS-DPFF-S0.2M, which the certificate's literal "male/female" wording does not name. sources.subject: rs232 cable (OEM)
sources.evidence:
The quoted mail text is all genuine (thread 'rs232 cable (OEM)', BOR/guzhiyi, msgs 6-8, 14, 17-18, 21 in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-lanstar-mail2/752f8fc5-be77-4ab5-bb66-347588e328d1/scratchpad/retry_packets/r_019.json). Msg 14 (2021-05-11) even adds "Proceed with the same product as the 9pin-25pin sample", so the RoHS request of 2021-05-07 does concern a DB9F-DB25M serial cable. But the catalogue link is refuted on three independent grounds.

(1) The OEM cable is NOT the LS-SER-9F25M product; the archive keeps them explicitly separate. BOR's own drawing for the ordered item is QJ/XYT-A200300, P/N block "DB25M/DB9F-3C+1, L=2000±50MM", 7/0.12 CCS x 3C + drain, AL foil, PVC OD 4.40mm, grey, no LS code anywhere. LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M is a different drawing, QJ/XYT-A201200: 6C+1, 1800±30mm, jacket printed "<LANstar><RoHS>". BOR mailed BOTH drawings side by side in the same mails — INBOX:6082 (2021-12-12 "DATA sheet of New Supplier": DB25M-DB9F-3C+1-2M.pdf + LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M.pdf + 6 other LS-SER drawings), and again at INBOX:7905/8901 (2022). Seven of the eight files carry an LS code; only the 3C+1 2m one does not, because Lanstar never gave it one. Lanstar itself distinguishes serial SKUs by conductor count (2021-12-02 sample mail: "LS-SER-9MM-1.8M ... 9C+1", "LS-SER-9FF-1.8M ... 7C+1"), so 3C+1 vs 6C+1 is a model-level difference, not a suffix. Kyu reinforces it: "This cables pin map is different other cables", "(OEM) PE BAG", "pack with PE bag without sticker" — an unbranded customer-specific build. No LS-SER-9F25M-2M SKU exists anywhere in the corpus; LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M is the only 9F25M part number.

(2) The document is not product-specific at all. sha1 49f6ef6f... is byte-identical (300,264 B) to "HDPE-ROHS.PDF" at INBOX:3885, "ROHS - USB screw cable" (2021-03-23), where it is already mapped high-confidence to LS-USB2.0-AMAF-SXM because kyu's request there names that model. Gu's covering note in the rs232 thread confirms the reuse: "Actually all products are compliant with RoHS now ... not necessary to supply your dealer test report every time". It is a 2018 SGS report on HDPE granule submitted by KUNSHAN ZATTAI — boilerplate BOR material paperwork, not evidence about the serial cable.

(3) The correct RoHS provenance for the LS-SER family is a different mail. INBOX:7770 "Serial cable ROHS sheet" (2022-07-27), answering kyu's explicit request for ROHS of the "serial cable with New factory", is where the LS-SER material reports come from (e.g. Aluminum Foil-ROHS.pdf, CTI A2210389700101001, Changzhou Lifan) and it is already mapped across the LS-SER families including LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M. Grafting the 2021 USB-thread HDPE report onto LS-SER-9F25M would put a foreign material dossier under that model. Note also that the LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M drawing specifies CCS/CCA conductors, AL foil, PVC jacket and LD-PE (not HDPE) inner mould, so there is no material-level bridge either.

Catalogue uniqueness is also weaker than claimed: the family key in family_catalog_short.json is LS-SER-9F25M-1.8M (a single 1.8m SKU), and neighbouring families LS-SER-9FF / 9MF / 9MFC / 9MM / 25MF / 25MM are equally plausible recipients of a generic BOR material report sent in a serial-cable thread — which is exactly why a generic material report cannot be pinned to one of them. No honest model or family link can be made for this document instance. | 동일 파일이 다른 메일에서 이미 확정됨(중복 병합)

caveat_ko: 파일명에 'ROHS'가 있지만 RoHS 시험성적서가 아닙니다 — 할로겐(불소 58, 염소·브롬·요오드 ND mg/kg)과 안티몬(ND) 함량만 시험한 원자재(PBT 백색 수지) 성적서로 RoHS 판정이 없습니다. RoHS 요청에는 동일 소재의 CANEC2119011813을 사용해야 하며, 이 파일은 무할로겐(Halogen-free) 근거 자료로만 유효합니다. 완제품이 아닌 원자재 단위 문서입니다.

sources.subject: Re: ROHS / MSDS for BOOT-COVER / OPEN
sources.evidence:
Product-type link CONFIRMED and upgraded; revise only to add the omitted model LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN.

1) Cited evidence verified verbatim. retry_packets/r_012.json (doc 2, INBOX:10468, 2023-05-04): kyu "We need ROHS or MSDS sheet for BOOT-COVER / OPEN"; Gu (guzhiyi@bor-cable.com) "RJ45 boot cover or open only use one material: PVC", attaching PVC-MSDS.pdf + PVC-ROHS2.0-2022-04-13.pdf.

2) Refutation attempt failed — stronger, model-named evidence exists. packets/batch_033.json thread 0: kyu 2026-06-19 subject "Request for Updated RoHS, REACH, and SGS Test Reports for LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN" ("the LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN boot cover product"); Gu's 2026-06-22 reply attaches the BYTE-IDENTICAL file (sha1 ab4012eb..., "PVC  MSDS.pdf") plus YCCT PVC SVHC/RoHS reports, and the follow-up attaches "RJ45 PVC BOOT.pdf" (5f85a3bf...) — the datasheet the catalogue model list derives from. So the link rests on a model-named delivery of the same sha1, not merely on a catalogue inference. Link method should read direct thread evidence, confidence high (not medium/catalogue_match).

3) Catalogue uniqueness holds. Across all 364 entries in family_catalog_short.json, LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN is the only RJ45 PVC boot family ("RJ45 PVC BOOT — MODEL LIST: LSN-BOOT-COVER-GR(GREY), -BLACK, -R, -Y, -B, -G, -O, -W(TRANSPARENT) ... 28.0x14.0mm / cable hole D6.5"). Other 부트 hits are fibre patchcord/pigtail boots (LS-FMD-*, LS-FSD-*, LS-FMP-*, LS-FSP-*) where the boot is an internal component of a different finished product, and LS-DC-RJ45BK / LS-DC-RJ45-BKC which is an ABS dust cover, not a PVC boot. No family fits equally well. Note kyu's "OPEN" (open boot) has no separate catalogue family.

4) DEFECT — omitted model. The claim lists the 8 colour variants but drops LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN, which is the code kyu himself uses in the request mail and the most frequent boot code in the archive (163 occurrences vs 88 for -W). final_data.json /docs/399 already stores LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN as the model for this sha1 (source INBOX:27143, confidence high). Without it a customer querying LSN-BOOT-COVER-WN would not receive this MSDS. Models corrected to 9 codes; family unchanged.

5) Union caveat. This is a raw-material MSDS for PVC compound (issuer 象山争达金塑制品有限公司 / Xiangshan Zhengda), byte-identical (md5 312582cf0bedf1af40b7b1fe9f574076) across five threads. final_data.json /docs/399 also links it, each with its own model-named request mail, to LS-UTP5H-300MG (INBOX:8371 "We need MSDS sheet for LS-UTP5H-300MG"), LS-F6-UTPD-XM (INBOX:7057), LS-DC-RJ45-BKC (INBOX:4605, "the dust cover is PVC material only") and LS-F6UTPD-XM (INBOX:15891). Those remain valid; the list above answers only the BOOT-COVER thread and must be unioned with, not substituted for, them. Serve with the existing caveat that this is a jacket/moulding raw-material MSDS, not a finished-product certificate. [검증-수정] | 동일 파일이 다른 메일에서 이미 확정됨(중복 병합)

caveat_ko: 랜스타 완제품 인증서가 아닙니다. 발행 대상이 중국 제조사 ZHEJIANG SHIP ELECTRONICS이고 대상은 패치패널·키스톤잭·페이스플레이트·모듈·박스·플러그 제품군이며, 문의 모델 LSP-GIC-UJW(커플러) 모델명은 문서 어디에도 없습니다. 파일명에 'CE证书'라고 되어 있으나 실제로는 RoHS 지령(2011/65/EU + (EU)2015/863) 적합성 검증서이므로 CE 인증서로 안내하면 안 됩니다. 완제품 케이블 RoHS 요청 시 단독 제공 금지이며, 커플러 RoHS 요청 시에도 '제조사 제품군 단위 BV 검증서'임을 반드시 함께 안내하세요. 또한 같은 메일에서 공급사는 LSP-GIC-UJW에 대한 UL 인증서는 없다고 회신했으므로 UL 요청에는 제공할 수 없습니다.

sources.subject: Test report for Fiber cable
sources.evidence:
FAMILY LINK HOLDS, MODEL LINK REFUTED. Quoted thread evidence is genuine: msg1 Gu 2025-01-16 "We have changed the manufacture to SKYLLYNN since this year. Please find attached ROHS/CE certificate" with attachment Fiber Cable-ROHS证书.pdf (= this sha1); msg2 kyu 2025-01-17 "We need test report about OM3-LCLC-15M"; msg6/7 Gu 2025-02-10 attach LS-OM3-LCLC-15M-test report.png / -测试报告.png. So SKYLYNN is confirmed as the current maker of Lanstar's BOR-sourced fibre patch cords and this is their RoHS.

REFUTATION of models=["LS-OM3-LCLC-15M"] — four independent grounds:
(1) Document scope is blanket, not model-specific. Certificate text: "Product: Fiber Optic Patch Cords / Model(s): SC/APC, SC/UPC, LC/UPC, LC/APC, FC/UPC, FC/APC, ST/UPC, ST/APC. MU, DIN, MTRJ ETC." Holder/manufacturer SHENZHEN SKYLYNN, issued by Shenzhen ZKT 2018-11-12, ZKT-2018111723C. It carries no length, no fibre grade (the strings OM3/OM4/OS2 never appear), and no Lanstar code.
(2) Chronology inverts the claim. The cert was attached 2025-01-16; kyu first named OM3-LCLC-15M on 2025-01-17, one day LATER. The cert cannot have been sent for a model that had not yet been mentioned; it was sent in reply to a model-less "FIBER cable" request.
(3) Wrong document type. The 2025-01-17 model naming was a request for a fluke/patch-cord TEST REPORT, which Gu supplied separately on 2025-02-10 as its own attachment. The RoHS cert was never re-sent alongside the model. kyu's own msg0 ("We have ROHS and CE sheet for FIBER cable") treats RoHS as a per-supplier line document, not per-model.
(4) Demonstrated reuse: the prior pass records the identical cert re-sent for LS-OM3-LCLC-20M (INBOX:20459), so a 15M attribution is provably not exclusive.

CIRCULAR EVIDENCE FOUND. The claim cites the catalogue as independent confirmation of LS-OM3-LCLC, but family_catalog_short.json["LS-OM3-LCLC"] (and the stray key "OM4-LCLC") contain THIS certificate's own text ("Product: Fiber Optic Patch Cords / Model(s): SC/APC... ZKT-2018111723C"), not a BOR drawing. Only LS-OM3-LCSC, LS-OM4-LCLC and LS-OM4-LCSC carry real BOR 제품사양서 drawings dated 2023-03-11 with the ladder 1M/3M/5M/10M/15M/20M/30M — those do establish the OM-series line and that a -15M exists, but they are not evidence about this cert.

FAMILY BREADTH TESTED. On the cert's own connector enumeration (LC/UPC, SC/UPC) the BOR duplex fibre patch-cord families LS-FMD-LCLC, LS-FMD-LCSC, LS-FMD-SCSC, LS-FSD-LCLC, LS-FSD-LCSC, LS-FSD-SCSC fit exactly as well — the cert draws no line at OM3/OM4 or at LC-terminated. I did NOT add them because the catalogue key "LS-FMD / LS-FMP" carries a competing blanket CE naming Ningbo Eonkey Optical Communication as applicant/manufacturer, indicating that 2025-07-15 line routes through a different maker; extending a SKYLYNN cert there would be the wrong-manufacturer error. The retained four are the coherent OM-series duplex patch-cord line whose supplier this thread explicitly identifies as SKYLYNN. Pigtail families (LS-FMP-*, LS-FSP-*) excluded: simplex single-connector form factor, not "patch cords".

NET: keep the four families as a family-level (blanket) RoHS; drop the single model. Confidence medium, not high — the model refutation is solid, but the three unanchored OM families rest on product-line grouping rather than direct evidence. [검증-수정] | 동일 파일이 다른 메일에서 이미 확정됨(중복 병합)
